svg.text: Route: /staff/orders?tab=new · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• Staff ring up a walk-in customer who doesn't use the kiosk. The menu: search, category chips, a tile per dish with its price and what's left (servings, or pieces for a ready-made item);
sold-out dishes are greyed out and can't be added, and the menu reloads as stock changes (inventory:updated).
• Tapping a dish opens a small sheet: quantity, the dish's own special-instruction options and a note for the kitchen (140 characters together), Add N · ₱…. The same dish with the same
instructions adds to its line; lines can be changed with − / + or removed.
• Charge places a counter order (POST /api/orders as staff: source “counter”, no kiosk session) and opens the payment step (19c). Closing that without paying leaves the order in the Queue,
unpaid. If a dish ran out meanwhile, the error says so and the menu reloads.
